newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee remained unchanged at 41.45 to the dollar on Tuesday as the supply of the U.S. currency matched its demand, dealers said.
"There is both good supply and demand for the U.S. currency," dealer Owais Kalia said. "The dollar will remain stable at these levels in the near term."
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended unchanged at 2.60 percent.
